resumen: Reserva: lunes 21 de septiembre a las 8:00, Dra. Núria Ferrer, Arenal Norte

eventos.texto: Good afternoon, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'd like to book orthopedics at Arnall Norte, whatever soonest.
Entiende cuándo la quiere: lo antes posible
Could I take your full name, and either your DNI or NIE, or the phone number on your file?
DNI oído 25•••62•: prefijo del NIE deducido: Z
Ese DNI no está en el directorio
I can't find that number. Could you read me the DNI again, digit by digit, with the letter at the end?
Ficha encontrada: Diego M. (por DNI y nombre)
Ofrece el lunes 21 de septiembre a las 8:00 con la Dra. Núria Ferrer en Arenal Norte
Thank you, Diego, I have your record here. The earliest I have is Monday the 21st of September at 8 am with Dra. Núria Ferrer at Arenal Norte. Shall I book that for you?
Reserva · lunes 21 de septiembre, 8:00 · Dra. Núria Ferrer · Arenal Norte
That's booked: Monday the 21st of September at 8 am with Dra. Núria Ferrer at Arenal Norte. Is there anything else I can help with?
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
